svg.aria-label: logitech_bcc950: A talking eyeball on a stick: pan, tilt and zoom control for the Logitech BCC950 on Linux.
svg.title: logitech_bcc950: A talking eyeball on a stick: pan, tilt and zoom control for the Logitech BCC950 on Linux.
svg.desc: The BCC950 drawn as an eyeball on a stick: it pans and tilts around, its pupil zooms over the camera's 100 to 500 range, it blinks, and a speech bubble of level bars talks.
